title: Ryu-based SDN firewall: policy management framework, measurement scripts and data
description: Reimplementation of a Ryu 4.34 firewall for SDN (REST administration with HTTP Basic authentication, JSON persistence, threshold-based detection) together with the Mininet measurement scripts (E1-E6 and the diagnostic experiments E1b and E1c), raw CSV data and analysis code used in the article submitted to the Journal of Network and Systems Management.
